verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair privacy question for an AI design tool, but the evidence pack never mentions a training opt-out, data-usage controls, or a training policy. The nearest items cover other features: an Enterprise admin toggle that enables or disables Claude Design itself, and data export. Neither is a control over whether user data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
